title: Governed OpenAPI generated refresh for protected Production promotion

phases.objective: Use the registered exact-head generated-artifact writer on a governed work branch to reconcile openapi/frontend-runtime-routes.generated.yaml with the already-reviewed source tree before protected main-to-Production promotion.

e2e_journeys.actor: read-only refresh request, trusted dispatcher, and governed generated-artifact writer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A labeled same-repository pull request from a governed gpt branch to main emits an exact-head refresh request after a synchronize event.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The registered writer updates only bounded deterministic OpenAPI artifacts on the exact branch head, pushes normally without force, and dispatches read-only verification for the resulting SHA.
steps: Create the governed refresh branch from the exact main head blocked by Protected Promotion Generated Artifact Refresh.
Use a temporary non-runtime trigger file only to emit a synchronize event after the explicit generated-artifact-refresh label is attached.
Let the protected default-branch request workflow validate the open same-repository PR, main base, governed branch, label, and exact current head without candidate checkout or mutation.
Let the trusted dispatcher revalidate the request artifact and invoke governed-generated-artifact-refresh.yml with the typed confirmation and exact target SHA.
Let the registered maintenance tool generate only allowlisted artifacts, reject unexpected paths, create the bounded generated commit, and dispatch exact-head read-only verification.
Remove the temporary trigger file and retain only this E2E contract plus writer-produced generated artifacts before merge.
assertions: openapi/frontend-runtime-routes.generated.yaml is produced by the registered governed writer and is not edited or copied manually.
The writer targets only the governed work branch and rejects main and Production.
The expected head SHA is validated before mutation and the writer uses a normal non-force push.
The temporary trigger file is absent from the final reviewed tree.
The final exact-head OpenAPI and frontend generated-artifact checks report no deterministic drift.

No runtime handler, authorization behavior, database row, SQL, migration, provider call, credential access, deployment, Production mutation, external send, protected-branch bypass, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: Observe canonical request, dispatcher, writer, and read-only verification evidence bound to the final exact branch head.
Retain fail-closed handling for stale heads, absent labels, protected targets, unexpected generated paths, inactive writer registration, and unobserved delegated runs.
This repository artifact refresh performs no external provider or deployment canary.
This PR does not promote, deploy, migrate, or mutate Production; it only removes deterministic generated-artifact drift through the governed writer.
